title: Miss Destiny - Do You Believe? (Radio Edit) (2009)

lines.l: Do you think I understand how you crashed into my heart?
Do you think I understand what I feel right from the start?
Do you believe, believe in your love like ours?
Like you simply love the power, with passion and soul?
Do you believe, believe in the things I told you
Believe that I will hold you, when you're feeling down
Don't you know, like the way I feel
Like the way I love you
Don't you know, don't you know
Do you think I'll make it right if I love you more and more?
Every single day and night like I never did before
Do you believe, believe in a love like I were?
Like I simply love with power, with passion and soul
Do you believe, believe in the things I told you to, believe that I will hold you, when you're feeling down?
